directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai keeps the printed wording for Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe. The listed path is /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe. It shows: Brick stele carved with red Chinese characters, with a traditional pavilion and a red stair behind it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Straight concrete pump delivery pipe. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. The published cells are: Part type Straight concrete pump delivery pipe. The section “Pressure acting on underground pipes due to weight of soil and transport.” is only the heading taken from the source page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台保留混凝土泵输送管已印出的说法。已列路径是 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe。这一页没有印理论输送量。不要自编 m³/h。向邢台问哪一条已列机型对得上你要的产量。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。河北品锦机械在邢台把混凝土泵输送管列在 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe。只抄已印格子：配件类型 混凝土泵直管。主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-pipe。已公布的格子是：配件类型 混凝土泵直管。商务条款 不支持小批量发货；无公开标价。页面没有印的格子保持空白。「压力 作用 在 地下 管道 由于 到 重量的土壤与输送.」只是取自来源页的节标题。
